obligations.note: The new `_log.error` call in `deliver_statement` builds the log message with an f-string that includes `self._store.get_payee(payee_id).account_number`. That writes an unmasked account number, which is NPI under `payments.npi_fields`, into an application log on the error path. Field masking does not apply to message text, and the passing sample-only control test does not outweigh the defect visible in the code.

The diff changes only the error-log line in the except branch. `deliver_statement` still records `self._audit(actor, "deliver_statement", ...)` on success, and no audited operation is altered. The sample AUD-1 control test is listed as passing.
No approved, unexpired exception covers a LOG-1 deviation in a payments component. EXC-0167 is scoped to `mortgage.logging` and covers masked last-4 only, so the deviation is not excepted.
Ticket CHG-26130 is a standard ticket. Change manager Grace Kim approved it on 2026-10-01, before the change opened. Its component `payments.service` covers the only touched file, `service.py`.
Sofia Santos gave the `code_review` approval. She holds `change_approver` for payments and is a different person from the author, Mara Costa.
The approval names head commit f8477793, which is the only commit on the change.

`run.json` reports success on head from ci-runner-04, started 2026-10-04. The attached JUnit report, however, is timestamped 2026-10-23, after the 2026-10-06 review time, and its hostname is a personal Mac. So it cannot be confirmed as the output of this CI run on the final commit.
The acceptance-ledger entries cover `payments.py`, `audit.py`, `routes.py` and mortgage files. The change touches only `service.py`, so no ledger evidence lapses.

summary: The change adds the payee's raw account number to the text of a statement-delivery error log. That puts unmasked NPI into application logs, which directly violates LOG-1. No exception in the register covers this deviation for payments. Ticket, independent review and approval-on-head are in order, but the CI JUnit report's timestamp and host do not match the recorded CI run. The change is rejected because of the LOG-1 violation.
